Independent full source/type/definition/body review of original lem:wall-sides, reference/SM/sm-1-polygons.tex lines 896–1020, with the F/V/T/E/C hypotheses at def:walls lines 710–750 and the inherited actual polygon, chirotope, crossing, visit, chamber and wall-germ conventions. The reviewer did not author Lean or edit its declaration map. This review certifies only the complete wall-sides lemma, not the full separate def:walls, a cusp theorem, a main wall-crossing law or the soft theorem. It closes the lem:wall-sides gaps recorded in the unchanged historical checkpoint038 partial report; that report remains historical evidence.

FULL SOURCE DOMAIN AND AGGREGATE. SM.wall_sides takes one arbitrary actual WallGerm at the inherited polygon size n>=3; NeZero n is redundant under that bound. WallSidesData is the conjunction of all five source branch implications for that same germ. It therefore covers every germ satisfying one of the printed F/V/T/E/C conditions, rather than assuming one branch or replacing the source by a theorem about an arbitrary supplied record. Each branch returns its genuine common local radius where the source requires shrinking. The transparent branch predicates were independently checked in this review even though the larger def:walls row remains unaccepted: the source lemma does not require K, its newborn/loop/empty conventions, or a separate proof of mutual exclusivity to establish these five implications. No central Generic, supplied crossing correspondence, derivative condition, oracle word or unproved wall law is a premise.

The germ is continuous on its actual positive-radius real open interval and Generic at every nonzero parameter. F retains its n>=4 bound, exact singleton turn support, empty concurrence support, strict betweenness and actual turn-sign change. V and E retain the exact four excluded cyclic labels and singleton contact support; V uses actual base-segment interior membership, E uses actual line membership and exclusion from the closed finite segment. Both retain the actual contact chi sign change. The index arguments derive n>=5 and the only possible forward consecutive pair, rather than adding cardinality restrictions. C uses the actual singleton point-zero support, which forces three distinct members; its successor-exclusion condition is exactly no consecutive pair in either orientation on that support, and its disjoint successor image proves n>=6. T's actual singleton concurrence set forces three distinct remote edges, while its empty point-zero set gives G1 at the centre. All three specified actual crossing-parameter differences have the source real SignChanges condition. This is exactly a negative product at opposite small real parameters, not a differentiability assumption.

GENERAL REGULARITY AND NONCRITICAL CHIROTOPES. Every branch proves actual Regular of the centre. F permits its positive-flat turn and excludes antiparallel directions through strict betweenness. V/E/C have no consecutive zero triple, so every actual turn determinant is nonzero. The proof derives nonzero edges and the non-antiparallel RegularPair condition, without requiring G1 at these nongeneric centres. T uses the actual central G1. ChirotopesOutsideZerosAgree quantifies every ordered triple of distinct labels whose support is outside the actual central zero set. Membership equivalence proves its central chi is nonzero, and finite continuity supplies the same nonzero sign on the branch's common interval. This uses the source's distinct point-triple convention; repeated-index chirotopes retain their separately proved zero values.

F AND E/C: ALL ACTUAL RECORDS, INCLUDING ZERO. FlatWallSidesData and SilentSidesData assert complete support persistence, all same-edge crossing-parameter comparisons and actual GeometricRecordsAgree on a common radius including zero and both sides. F's central geometry is derived from the singleton positive-flat hypotheses. E/C centres satisfy the complete accepted WeakGeneric predicate, derived from actual nonzero turns, vertex exclusion, transverse remote meetings and full G2. In E the unique possible nonincident vertex incidence is (M,a); the printed exclusion of M from the closed base segment therefore rules out every such contact. This checks the finite segment condition, and does not forbid disjoint remote parallel or collinear segments. Nonzero determinant is required only at an actual remote meeting. C's no-consecutive support rules out all such incidences. Nonzero-turn adjacent edges cannot share an interior point, so empty remote-concurrence support gives full G2.

GeometricRecordsAgree compares all finite crossing supports, not a selected list. Its visits are the actual crossing/incident-edge sigma type with actual intersection parameter. The complete sorted finite universe gives the Gauss list and its Cycle word modulo rotation. The construction is proved equal to the accepted Generic definitions wherever Generic holds and remains an actual segment construction at the F/E/C centres. The record theorem proves equality of independently formed full lists and words under the canonical support/edge-preserving equivalences, hence constant crossing pairing and the actual alternating-visit interlacement. Directed determinant signs are also retained. Empty crossing/visit sets and equal-partner order comparisons are covered. Thus the full F and E/C crossing-set/Gauss-word assertions at the centre and both sides are present, without evaluating a Generic-only function at those centres.

V: EXACT CROSSING PATTERNS AND FINITE-SEGMENT TEST. ContactSeparated and the unique point-zero support classify every possible endpoint incidence as precisely the specified vertex on the specified base edge. On every other remote support, a closed meeting avoids all endpoints and is transverse/interior; a parallel meeting would force more than the one allowed zero point triple. Pairwise segment stability and finite quantification prove both directions of persistence on every unaffected support. The contact legs use exactly the source tail labels M-1 and M, with the correct predecessor/successor neighbours. Both neighbour chi signs are proved nonzero. Strict interior contact gives the second strict separation of the base endpoints by the leg line at the centre, with both leg orientations handled. That second test persists by continuity. The full two-segment criterion therefore identifies an actual crossing precisely with opposite contact/neighbour signs; line straddling alone is never substituted for a finite-segment crossing.

Actual sign algebra then proves the finite crossingSet symmetric difference is exactly the two displayed, proved distinct supports. Equal neighbour signs give both crossings on one side and neither on the other; unequal nonzero signs give exactly one crossing on each side and exchange the two. The branch classification is the actual central chi equality/inequality from the source. These are facts about IsCrossing, not auxiliary booleans. A small actual sample is transported through each connected Generic half-interval using proved crossing constancy. The full side theorem allows independently chosen positive and negative parameters, so a bigon/sliding orientation cannot fluctuate with a paired sample. No other support is created or lost.

V: CENTRAL INTERIOR UNIVERSE AND ACTUAL PERSISTENT VISITS. The earlier endpoint caveat is now resolved by an explicit theorem included in VertexSidesData. IsInteriorCrossing is defined by an actual remote pair, nonzero direction determinant and a common point in both actual interiors. At the V centre it is equivalent to raw closed IsCrossing together with exclusion of the two ContactAffected supports. For an affected pair, its nonzero central determinant gives unique Cramer parameters, and the leg parameter is exactly its contact endpoint (one on the predecessor, zero on the successor). A supposed common interior point would force a strict interior parameter to equal that endpoint. Conversely every unaffected closed meeting is proved transverse/interior. This gives exact exhaustion, not merely one inclusion. PersistentContactVisit therefore represents precisely the source central interior-crossing visits; raw endpoint contacts are not counted as central source crossings or visits.

The actual persistent crossing point/parameter bridge is proved without global central CrossingGeometry. Coincident parameters of distinct persistent crossings on one edge would create a forbidden full central three-interior concurrence; full G2 is derived from the source hypotheses, not assumed. Persistent crossing points avoid every vertex, including M, by the exact incidence classification and endpoint injectivity of nonzero edges. Thus the base parameters differ from the central contact parameter and the leg parameters differ from their contact endpoints.

V: FINITE SIMULTANEOUS LOCALIZATION AND UNCHANGED ORDER. A finite positive lower bound, with a positive sentinel for empty sets, covers every persistent crossing partner on the base and both legs. The chosen positive eta has four eta strictly below both distances of the base contact parameter to its endpoints and below every central persistent distance to the three window centres. Actual Cramer continuity moves every persistent parameter by less than eta. Complete unaffected-support persistence recovers every nearby unaffected crossing, and the triangle inequality gives distance greater than three eta from its window centre. The changing-pair Cramer parameters approach the actual base contact and correct leg endpoint, hence lie within eta. These are exact actual line parameters, and the proved Generic crossing/visit bridges are applied only to punctured values where the germ supplies G1.

ContactVisitWindows proves for every actual nearby visit that membership in one of the three windows is equivalent to belonging to a ContactAffected crossing. Thus every outside-window visit is persistent, every actual affected visit is inside, and no visit is omitted or artificially supplied. contactVisitTransport constructs the equivalence of the complete persistent visit subtypes using unchanged supports and edge labels, with proved inverses. The actual chosen parameters under this map have every same-edge comparison preserved, including equal visits/partners. VertexLocalData combines noncritical chi, all persistent comparisons, complete support windows, exact actual visit-window membership and exhaustive persistent visit order on one common radius. Its G1 implications at a nearby value are discharged by punctured Generic; it does not assume G1 at zero. Together these statements provide the source's no order changes outside the contact neighbourhood on the actual traversal, not merely convergence of selected parameters.

T: ALL AND ONLY THE NAMED ORDER EXCHANGES. At the central G1 tuple, equality of two parameters for distinct partners on a common edge gives an actual common point in three interiors. The other edges are proved remote, so the support is in the actual concurrence set. Conversely the named concurrence gives that equality. Hence the only possible central tie is exactly the selected three-element support. Every other comparison is locally constant by actual Cramer continuity and nonzero central difference; equal partners are handled explicitly. Actual G1 support persistence includes every crossing and applies without central G2. Constancy on each connected Generic side extends the comparison results to independent positive/negative evaluation parameters.

Each of the three source SignChanges conditions yields both orientations of its strict order reversal. The explicit six-permutation theorem covers every ordering of the unordered support. ExactTriangleParameterOrders classifies all same-edge crossing partner pairs. Its bridge to ExactTriangleVisitOrders quantifies every pair of actual visits on a common edge and classifies it by the union of the two actual crossing supports. It constructs the partner indices, proves that union is the corresponding three-index support and rewrites all chosen visit parameters through the actual Generic parameter bridge. The canonical full visit transport preserves supports and edge labels. Equal visits have a two-element union and belong to the unchanged branch; all and only the actual triangle comparisons reverse. No arbitrary input triangle visits or pair selection is used.

TripleWallSidesData then combines complete support constancy, all noncritical chi, all comparisons outside the named support and the accepted TripleSides result on one common interval. At every nonzero point of this interval, the three actual crossing points exist and are distinct, and on each selected edge the relevant visits occupy consecutive indices of the complete actual Gauss list. With the exact comparison reversals, these are the source's three adjacent exchanges; every other visit order is fixed. The centre is allowed its actual triple tie. No central G2, injective central visit-position map or Generic Gauss word is asserted there.

INTERVALS AND LABELLED CONVENTIONS. Every branch uses a positive radius bounded by the original germ radius and quantifies all original real interval-subtype points with absolute value below it. General sign/support/order claims cover zero where meaningful; selected T adjacency and Generic visit bridges are explicitly punctured. Side statements are stronger independent-parameter statements on the actual connected sides. The full aggregate concerns one fixed arbitrary germ and all its source branch implications, so no unrelated family is substituted. All edge labels, the cyclic predecessor/successor convention and positive versus negative side evaluations are the actual ones. The formulation retains the source-permitted labelled representation and genuine cyclic Gauss words; no reversal or quotient by arbitrary permutations is introduced.

FROZEN INDEPENDENT BINDINGS. Checkpoint039 and stage-development.json are byte-identical with SHA256 ee1c5200e18adb955e307525d4df247d8003fb80ee639d173b52bde8f8e5340b, passed=true, stage=null and stage_accepted=false. I recomputed every one of the 182 project-file hashes and all 38 frozen bundle hashes, and verified the exact 176-module SM inventory. The audit has 1717 local declarations and 25 mapped claims. Recomputing the canonical JSON digest of the 151 semantic definition entries for SM.wall_sides gives 4437240a488e0fa8f4c9ab0a6446fa19489ba9e81ca971a15a2f9656878e31bd. The semantic inventory includes the full transparent WallSidesData, every branch predicate/data definition, actual central crossing interpretation, parameter windows and actual visit transports; it has no custom axiom entry. Current declaration-audit.json SHA256 is 998591ebbb59d1328bc2e3b1bc7eae35a779f2dfd8b7077b844536c665adc9b8. The inspected full type/definition/axiom trace has SHA256 1abf9ac2684c2c23d3132ca08896d7eb04a263604f62f8aa2f824aa5e0b3f97a. All five traced theorem axiom sets contain only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Proof bodies were independently reviewed from current Lean sources rather than inferred from an audit omitting theorem bodies.

The 107-file import closure below binds that cumulative review: all 78 checkpoint038 files remain unchanged, fourteen new implementation files were independently inspected through the final compiling revisions, and the other fifteen files match previous accepted independent reviews. No Lean or declaration-map mutation was made by this reviewer. The current lem:wall-sides map is status review; only this one complete original claim is certified as faithful for subsequent acceptance. The separate def:walls row remains pending and unmapped, the original lem:shift omission remains separately recorded, and neither helpers nor historical partial reviews add original proof counts. A passed development audit is not stage or main-target completion.

countersignature_20260913.reason:
Source (reference/SM/sm-1-polygons.tex:923-951, not reworded in SM15; CHANGES_SINCE_20260909.md section 1 does not list it): for a simple germ of type F/V/T/E/C (def:walls, lines 737-775), (a) P(0) in R_n; (b) after shrinking, every chirotope outside Z_pt is nonzero with constant sign; (c) every crossing not in the local degeneration persists and orders of persistent visits with distinct central parameters are constant; plus per-type clauses (F: crossing set and Gauss word same on both sides and at centre; V: bigon/sliding exchange of {a,M-1},{a,M}, nothing else created/lost, no order change outside the contact neighbourhood; T: same crossing set, only the triangle exchanges on E_e,E_f,E_g; E/C: same crossing set and Gauss word on both sides and at centre), with central crossing data read as transverse relative-interior intersections.

Lean: `SM.wall_sides (hn : 3 ≤ n) (g : WallGerm n) : WallSidesData hn g` (work/lean/SM/WallSides.lean:14-30) is the conjunction over all five type predicates of the corresponding branch data, for an arbitrary germ. `WallGerm` (WallGerm.lean:13-19) is exactly def:germ (continuous on an open interval of positive radius, generic off 0, nongeneric at 0). The type predicates (NamedWallPredicates.lean:15-49) match def:walls clause by clause: F = 4 ≤ n, pointZeros = {turnSupport j}, concurrences = ∅, StrictBetween, SignChanges (turn j); V = ContactSeparated (M ∉ {a-1,a,a+1,a+2}), pointZeros = {{a,a+1,M}}, no concurrences, center M ∈ edgeInterior a, SignChanges chi a (a+1) M; T = pointZeros = ∅, concurrences = {{e,f,k}}, three edge-parameter-difference sign changes; E = same as V but M on the line of E_a and outside the closed segment; C = NoConsecutive {i,j,k}, pointZeros = {{i,j,k}}, no concurrences, sign change of chi i j k. `SignChanges` (GermSignChange.lean:10-12) is the source's phi(P(t))phi(P(-t))<0 for 0<t<delta; `pointZeros`/`concurrences` are the source's Z_pt/Z_c (ZeroTriples.lean); `Regular` (RegularLocus.lean:12 with RegularPair) is the source's R_n; bigon/sliding test is chi center a (a+1) (M-1) = chi center a (a+1) (M+1) as printed.

Conclusions: (a) `Regular g.center` in every branch. (b) `ChirotopesOutsideZerosAgree g.center (g.curve t)` on a common |t|<delta in every branch (GermChiStability.lean:13-16: for distinct triples outside pointZeros, chi Q = chi P ≠ 0). (c) and the per-type clauses: F (FlatWallSides.lean:14-20) gives, on one interval including t=0, crossing-set equality, transported Gauss list/word, interlacement and sign equality (`GeometricRecordsAgree`, GeometricRecords.lean:55-61) and same-edge parameter order agreement, with the centre read through `CrossingGeometry` (closed-segment intersections of remote edges are interior and transverse, CrossingGeometry.lean:11-15), matching the interpretation clause. V (VertexSides.lean:17-40): for every pair of side parameters, crossingSet P+ ∆ crossingSet P- = {{a,M-1},{a,M}}, the bigon pattern (both/neither) or sliding pattern (exactly one each, exchanged) according to the printed chirotope test, unaffected crossings agree with the centre on both sides; and on one interval: chirotopes, order of unaffected same-edge crossings, explicit contact parameter windows (r = contact parameter, eta with 4eta<r, 4eta<1-r) containing exactly the affected visits on every nearby generic polygon, and transported order of all persistent visits on a common edge. T (TripleWallSides.lean:14-24): for every pair of side parameters the crossing sets agree, exactly the comparisons {i,j,k}={e,f,g} reverse and all others persist (both on edge parameters and on visits); on one interval chirotopes agree, crossings agree with the centre, non-triangle orders persist, and `TripleSides` holds off 0. E/C (SilentSides.lean:15-23): on one interval including 0, chirotopes, weak genericity, crossing geometry, same-edge parameter order and full geometric records (crossing set, Gauss list/word, interlacement, signs) agree with the centre. Nothing is vacuous: the domain is every WallGerm with n ≥ 3 and each type predicate is the printed one. Where Lean differs it is stronger (listed below); I found no clause of the printed statement that the Lean fails to assert.
stronger_than_source: Each branch supplies one common local radius delta (0<delta<=radius) for all its local clauses at once, and includes t=0; the source only says 'after shrinking the interval'.

V (VertexSides.lean:31-32, ContactCrossingSides.lean:12): the symmetric difference X(P+) ∆ X(P-) = {{a,M-1},{a,M}} is asserted in both the bigon and the sliding branch; the source displays it only for the bigon branch (it is implied by the sliding description).

V (VertexSides.lean:33-37, ContactWindows.lean:14-23, ContactVisitWindows.lean:12-15): the informal 'contact neighbourhood' is made explicit as parameter windows of radius eta (4eta<r, 4eta<1-r) around the contact parameters r on E_a, 1 on E_{M-1}, 0 on E_M, every other nearby crossing on those edges being more than 3eta away, and, on every nearby generic polygon, the visits inside the windows are exactly the visits of the two contact pairs.

V and T (VertexSides.lean:31, TripleWallSides.lean:16-19): side-to-side clauses are quantified over all pairs of side parameters s,t on the whole punctured interval (independent choices), not only near 0.

Order clauses (CrossingParameterOrderAgrees, ContactOrderAgrees, TripleUnchangedOrders, ExactTriangleParameterOrders) are iffs on the strict order, so a central tie would be preserved as a tie; the source restricts to pairs with distinct central parameters (the Lean also rules such ties out in F/V/E/C and confines them to the triangle in T).

T (TripleWallSides.lean:20-24): the crossing set is also constant at the centre, G1 holds along the whole interval, and TripleSides (all three triangle crossings, three distinct crossing points, adjacency of the two triangle visits on each of E_e,E_f,E_g) holds on each punctured side; the source states adjacency in lem:triple-sides, not here.

F and E/C (GeometricRecordsAgree): beyond crossing set and Gauss word, the interlacement relation and the crossing sign of every crossing are also preserved; E/C additionally assert WeakGeneric of every curve point, injectivity of crossing points and that no crossing point is a vertex.

V (VertexSides.lean:30): an explicit central interpretation clause, IsInteriorCrossing g.center c ↔ IsCrossing g.center c ∧ ¬ContactAffected M a c, formalizing the source's remark that central crossing data mean transverse relative-interior intersections; and the extra fact {a,M-1} ≠ {a,M}.
